Most the people having bought n flats in the apartmenst without consulting the vaasthu Siddhanthi and engineers  and after that they came to know by the way some Siddhanthi and then only they rush to the Siddhanthis and engineers for suggestions. The kitchen should be in the east mostly, or in the north northwest should be better.  If it is not possible the south southeast or north northwest can also be good for kitchen then the kitchen platform should be established towards east. The person who cooks should be facing towards east only. For the toilets in the apartments  no need of thinking about vaasthu for  those toilets.  But the toilets should be in the eastern northeast side. 
The remaining of the three corners can be established  toilets. And as per the Hall, dining there are no certain rules of vaasthu in the apartments. But the Hall, dining hall should be in the eastern northeast , southeast and northwest side corner is ideal for those to be established.
The children bed room must be constructed in the eastern northeast side or south west side or southeast side. The children bed room should be in the northern west side for good results.
